name: io.github.sji-xiaobenben/xiaobenben
title: 小本本 (xiaobenben)
description: Local-first long-term memory for AI assistants. Stores what you talk about in a SQLite file on your own machine and exposes it over MCP stdio, so any MCP client can recall it in later sessions without sending anything to a server.

packageArguments.description: Run the MCP stdio server (this is the mode MCP clients need)
